name: page-reader
title: Page Reader
description: A manga read page by page from a list of images ({ src, alt, width, height }). One page or two-page spreads (auto: spreads when the stage is wide and landscape; the cover stands alone), manga order (right to left: the next page is on the left, a spread puts the lower page on the right) or western order. Turn with the page edges (invisible zones that show a paper plate with a brush arrow on hover), the arrow keys (following the order), Page Up / Down, Home / End, a swipe (the page follows the finger with no steps, then turns or snaps back; it resists at both ends) or the toolbar. Fit: whole page, width (scrolls down) or height. Background: paper, ink or tone. Zoom 100–300 % with buttons, + / - / 0 or a double click at a point, then drag to pan. Full screen asks the browser (Fullscreen API on the document) and falls back to a fixed immersive mode (iOS Safari); Escape leaves. Pages around the current one are fetched ahead (preload), and a page known to be loaded shows at once. Each page is a ReaderPage (ink frame, loading panel, jagged error panel with Retry, a paper mat in dark mode). A turned page slides in from the side it comes from in three steps. An optional end view after the last page holds a ChapterEnd. The toolbar has a ReadingProgress with a page counter and a slot for your own buttons (settings, thumbnails). Controlled or not (page / onPageChange). Built at 375 px first: 44 px controls, two toolbar rows. PageReader also takes pages of the page model ({ page: PageData }), drawn by Page with real lettering; scans and data pages can be mixed.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/page-reader". Give each page its real width and height so the space is reserved before it loads. The reader sets data-reading on its root, so pieces inside (fill-in, ChapterEnd's arrow) follow its order. Pair it with ReaderSettings (direction, mode, fit, background) and PageThumbnails in a Sheet through the toolbar slot; for the strip mode render a ReaderStrip instead.

meta.tagline: A manga read page by page: spreads, reading order, swipe, zoom and full screen.

props.name: pages
props.type: ({ src: string; alt: string; width: number; height: number } | { page: PageData; alt?: string })[]
props.description: Scans, or pages of the page model, in reading order.

props.name: page
props.description: First page shown (0-based), controlled. pages.length is the end view when end is set.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Called with the first page of the new view.

props.name: spread
props.description: One page, two-page spreads, or spreads when the stage is wide and landscape.

props.name: coverAlone
props.description: In spreads, the first page stands alone.

props.name: direction
props.description: Manga order (next page on the left) or western order.

props.name: fit
props.description: Whole page in view, fill the width (scrolls down) or fill the height.

props.name: preload
props.description: Pages fetched ahead of and behind the view.

props.name: end
props.description: One more view after the last page, e.g. a ChapterEnd.

props.name: onEnd
props.description: Called on reaching the end view, or on asking past the last page when there is none.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Your own buttons in the toolbar (settings, thumbnails).

props.name: className
props.description: Added to the root; set its height here (default min(48rem, 88svh)).
